integrity: The proof is symbolic and exact. The only imported non-elementary premise is the coordinate-lifting criterion for Delta-points in \(c_0(X)\), checked in the cited primary sources.
scientific_limitations: No claim is made that three is the minimal universal number of Delta-points.
The construction is for the countable \(c_0\)-sum and uses three coordinates on which the target vector is small.
title: Three-point convex generation by Delta-points in \(c_0(X)\)
